definitions.explanation: the act of opening packages or boxes and removing their contents, especially after moving or receiving a delivery

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{荷解|にほど}きをする。
まだ{荷解|にほど}きが{終|お}わっていない。
{週末|しゅうまつ}に{残|のこ}りの{段|だん}ボールの{荷解|にほど}きをしなければならない。
examples.english: I have to unpack the remaining cardboard boxes this weekend.

notes:
{荷解|にほど}き means unpacking, typically used in the context of moving house or receiving deliveries.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {荷|に} (luggage, cargo)
- {解|ほど}く (to untie, undo)

USAGE:
- {荷解|にほど}きする (to unpack - suru verb)
- {荷解|にほど}きが{終|お}わる (to finish unpacking)
- {荷解|にほど}きが{進|すす}まない (unpacking isn't progressing)

COMMON CONTEXTS:
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{荷解|にほど}き (unpacking after moving)
- {旅行|りょこう}の{荷解|にほど}き (unpacking from a trip)

ANTONYM:
- {荷造|にづく}り (packing)
